purpose: Externalizes the existing EchoForge Rust detector implementations as YAML detector_card documents. Each card declares an algorithm_family (the slug the loader factory keys on), parameters (matching the Rust defaults), default_thresholds, intended_target_classes (referencing source_platform_card slugs from pack.adversary-platforms-v1), intended_sensor_archetypes (referencing radar_platform_card slugs from pack.radar-platforms-v1), an expected_performance_envelope, and academic citations. Covers the CFAR family (CA / OS / GO / SO), pulse-Doppler suppression (MTI / MTD / MTI+MTD chain), R-D clustering (blob), micro-Doppler (autocorrelation feature + 5-feature Neyman-Pearson LRT classifier), phase-aware tier detection (BOOST / CLIMB-OUT / CRUISE), Track-Before-Detect (Hough accumulator), and acoustic-radar Bayesian fusion. All 13 algorithms have been validated via the empirical_pfa calibrator (32/32 PASS at 1M trials per .agents/receipts/lane-g-c-multidist-cfar/) and named in published radar literature: Skolnik §7.7.2, Rohling 1983, Hansen & Sawyers 1980, Trunk 1978, Skolnik §3.7-3.8, Chen 2011, Tahmoush 2015, Rahman & Robertson Nature Sci Rep 2018, Carlson-Evans-Wilson 1994, Tonissen-Evans 1996, Salmond-Birch 2001, Stone & Streit 2018.

license.notice: Pack content derived from open-literature radar references (Skolnik, Richards, Rohling, Hansen & Sawyers, Trunk, Schleher, Chen, Tahmoush, Rahman & Robertson, Carlson-Evans-Wilson, Tonissen-Evans, Salmond-Birch, Stone & Streit). No measured-truth claim.

notes: 13 detector cards externalize the existing Rust detector implementations under crates/echoforge-radar/src/{cfar.rs, mti_mtd.rs, detectors/*.rs, fusion/*.rs}.
Each card's algorithm_family is the slug the pack-loader's factory table will key on once Wave 13 lands; the per-family Rust constructor will be invoked with the card's `parameters` block as input.

All thirteen algorithms cite canonical academic references (Skolnik / Rohling / Hansen-Sawyers / Trunk / Schleher / Chen / Tahmoush / Rahman-Robertson / Carlson-Evans-Wilson / Tonissen-Evans / Salmond-Birch / Stone-Streit / MDPI Drones).

OS-CFAR card validation tier is `benchmarked` (empirical_pfa 32/32 PASS at 1M trials per .agents/receipts/lane-g-c-multidist-cfar/). MTI card validation tier is `benchmarked` (I_3=73.09 dB per .agents/receipts/mti-mtd-filter-bank/). Phase-tiered card is `cross_checked` per .agents/receipts/phase-pd-pfa-report-v4/. Remaining cards declare tier=`basic`.

Cross-pack target/sensor slugs reference pack.adversary-platforms-v1 (shahed-136-geran-2, shahed-131-geran-1, geran-3-jet-variant, mohajer-6) and pack.radar-platforms-v1 (saab-giraffe-1x, rtx-an-mpq-64-sentinel-a4, rtx-kurfs, src-an-tpq-50).
